spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is a real photo of the university gate; image 4 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). A sunny day at the main gate of National Yunlin University of Science and Technology from image 3: a round stone gatehouse with a curved roof, a planter of red flowers in front, tall trees on both sides, a wide paved forecourt. The man points at the gate, telling the woman about his student days; she laughs. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
